node: Optical interconnect EMS and precision manufacturing for 800G and 1.6T transceivers
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around optical interconnect manufacturing rather than GPU or switch leaders. The strongest directly evidenced underfollowed candidate is Fabrinet, which appears to sit at the contract-manufacturing and optical assembly layer for high-speed AI data-center interconnects. Coherent and Lumentum are better-known reference suppliers for constrained photonics and InP-related capacity, useful as context anchors rather than pure EMS names. Aeluma is a speculative shadow candidate tied to alternative compound-semiconductor photonics scaling rather than transceiver EMS. Sanmina is included only as a weak underfollowed EMS hypothesis requiring verification for direct 800G/1.6T AI optical exposure.
